summary: Create Project Action Plan Template Reference
description: Create a Project Action Plan Template Reference

id.description: Unique identifier of the template reference.

plan_template_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the template item this reference belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the reference was created. ISO 8601 format.

payload.description: Contains type-specific attributes. Which fields are present depends on the type value.

drawing_id.description: Identifier of the drawing the drawing revision belongs to. Present when type is 'drawing'.

drawing_revision_id.description: Identifier of the latest drawing revision. Present when type is 'drawing'.

file_version_id.description: Identifier of the latest file version of the folder file. Present when type is 'document'.

folder_id.description: Identifier of the folder the file version belongs to. Present when type is 'document'.

specification_section_id.description: Identifier of the specification section. Present when type is 'specification_section'.

specification_section_current_revision_i.description: Identifier of the current revision of the specification section. Null if no revision exists.

generic_tool_item_id.description: Identifier of the generic tool item (correspondence). Present when type is 'generic_tool_item'.

form_id.description: Identifier of the form. Present when type is 'form'.

image_id.description: Identifier of the image. Present when type is 'image'.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the meeting. Present when type is 'meeting'.

observation_item_id.description: Identifier of the observation item. Present when type is 'observation_item'.

document_management_document_reference.description: Product Document Management (PDM) document reference details. Present when type is 'document_management_document_reference'.

collection_id.description: Unique identifier of the document collection.

container_id.description: Unique identifier of the document container.

document_revision_id.description: Identifier of the document revision. Null for templates; always shows latest for plans.

viewer_url.description: URL to view the document in the browser.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

type.description: Categorization of the reference. Determines which payload fields are populated.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the reference was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

plan_template_item_id.description: Project Action Plan Template Item ID

payload.description: One of attachment, drawing_revision_id, file_version_id, specification_section_id, generic_tool_item_id, form_id, image_id, meeting_id, or observation_item_id is accepted depending on the type prov...

attachment.description:
Reference Attachment.
To upload an attachment you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type
with the `attachment` file.
